raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With DP attention, when a peer rank runs extend, `maybe_convert_decode_to_extend` converts this rank's decode batch to extend in place. `get_next_batch_to_run` then swapped the running batch for an empty placeholder, `ScheduleBatch(reqs=[], batch_is_full=...)`, so that on the next step the converted batch would come back through the last-batch extend merge instead of merging with itself. The swap has two effects:

- **Admission stays closed.** The converted batch keeps the `batch_is_full` it had before the step. When some of its rows finish, the shrink reset (`running_batch.batch_is_full = False`) goes to the placeholder, and the placeholder is then replaced by the converted batch with its stale `True`. While a peer rank keeps extending, this repeats every step, so this rank stops admitting until its running batch drains.
- **Load is under-reported.** During the converted step the running batch is the empty placeholder, so `/v1/loads` reports 0 running requests for the rank and DP load balancing sees it as idle.

## Modifications

- `Scheduler.get_next_batch_to_run`: a converted running batch stays the running batch; the placeholder swap is removed.
- In the next step's extend merge, a last batch that is the running batch itself is filtered in place (resetting `batch_is_full` on the running batch when rows finished) and not merged.
- `Scheduler.pause_generation`: when the running batch is the converted last batch, its requests are listed for retraction once, not twice.
- `test/registered/unit/managers/test_scheduler_dp_converted_batch_full.py` (CPU): over two steps, the converted batch stays the running batch, is not merged with itself, and admission sees `batch_is_full=False` after a row finishes.

Related: #35609 (open) resets `batch_is_full` at the start of every admission pass, which would also reopen admission here but not fix the load report.

Only the DP-converted path changes. `running_batch` and `last_batch` being the same object is the usual state after a decode step, and the readers of both (the invariant checker, in-flight request collection) already handle it; `pause_generation` is the one reader that needed the identity check above.

## Checks

- New unit test: fails on `main` (the running batch is the placeholder), passes with this change.
- `test_retract_after_dp_conversion_releases_each_req_once` in `test_scheduler_pause_generation.py`: a retract pause with the running batch as last batch requeues each request once.
- Stall workload, Qwen3-0.6B, `--tp 2 --dp 2 --enable-dp-attention --max-running-requests 8` (4 running requests per rank), H200. DP rank 1 extends on nearly every step (three client loops sending 6000-token prompts with `max_new_tokens=1`, `routed_dp_rank=1`); DP rank 0 serves 24 streaming requests (`routed_dp_rank=0`, `ignore_eos`, 40-600 output tokens drawn with a fixed seed). `/v1/loads` polled every ~50 ms:

| seed | DP0 makespan, main (s) | DP0 makespan, this PR (s) | DP0 mean TTFT, main (s) | DP0 mean TTFT, this PR (s) | polls reporting 0 running while DP0 had requests in flight, main (%) | same, this PR (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 50.2 | 35.0 | 20.8 | 13.0 | 44.7 | 0 |
| 1 | 53.1 | 36.2 | 19.2 | 10.9 | 33.0 | 0 |
| 2 | 40.8 | 32.6 | 15.8 | 9.4 | 52.8 | 0 |
| 3 | 56.4 | 27.8 | 25.6 | 11.9 | 38.3 | 0 |
| 4 | 54.8 | 28.1 | 21.6 | 10.1 | 32.4 | 0 |

  - DP rank 0 decode steps with a free running slot and a non-empty waiting queue: 96 of 143 on `main`, 0 of 63 with this PR.
  - With DP rank 1 idle, both builds finish the same DP rank 0 workload in 3.7-4.7 s, with no under-reported load.
- No regression, `--tp 2 --dp 2 --enable-dp-attention`: 400 few-shot GSM8K questions (parallel 128) give 42.7% on `main` and 42.5% with this PR; 600 concurrent `/generate` requests of mixed lengths all return the requested tokens on both; no traceback in any server log.
- Unit tests under `test/registered/unit/managers/` and `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/` pass, apart from files that fail the same way on `main` locally.

         self._arm_prefill_decode_interval(ret)
 
         # Handle ngram embedding
@@ -5534,6 +5531,9 @@ def pause_generation(self, recv_req: PauseGenerationReqInput):
         if (
             self.last_batch is not None
             and self.last_batch.forward_mode.is_extend()
+            # A running batch that DP attention converted to extend is
+            # last_batch itself; its requests are already listed above.
+            and self.last_batch is not self.running_batch
             # Skip merge for disagg prefill: completed prefill requests are
             # already in disagg_prefill_inflight_queue. Merging them into
             # running_batch leaks them, since the prefill event loop never

@@ -0,0 +1,101 @@
+"""A running batch that DP attention converts to extend stays the running batch."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import DisaggregationMode
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import NextBatchPlan
+from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler import Scheduler
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _RunningBatch:
+    """A full running batch that DP attention converts to extend in place."""
+
+    def __init__(self, num_reqs):
+        self.reqs = [SimpleNamespace(finished=False) for _ in range(num_reqs)]
+        self.forward_mode = SimpleNamespace(is_extend=lambda: False)
+        self.chunked_req = None
+        self.is_prefill_only = False
+        self.batch_is_full = True
+
+    def convert_decode_to_extend(self):
+        self.forward_mode = SimpleNamespace(is_extend=lambda: True)
+        return self
+
+    def batch_size(self):
+        return len(self.reqs)
+
+    def is_empty(self):
+        return not self.reqs
+
+    def filter_batch(self, reqs_to_exclude=()):
+        self.reqs = [
+            r for r in self.reqs if not r.finished and r not in reqs_to_exclude
+        ]
+
+    def merge_batch(self, other):
+        raise AssertionError("a converted running batch must not be merged")
+
+
+class TestDpConvertedBatchFull(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _scheduler(self, seen):
+        s = Scheduler.__new__(Scheduler)
+        s.scheduler_stage_metrics = None
+        s.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.NULL
+        s.process_pending_chunked_abort = Mock()
+        s._process_hicache_events = Mock()
+        s.enable_fpm = False
+        s.dllm_config = None
+        s.chunked_req = None
+        s.enable_hisparse = False
+        s.require_mlp_sync = False
+        s._should_defer_prefill = Mock(return_value=False)
+        s.dp_attn_adapter = Mock()
+        s.dp_attn_adapter.maybe_prepare_mlp_sync_batch.side_effect = lambda b, **_: b
+        s.dp_attn_adapter.maybe_convert_decode_to_extend.side_effect = lambda b: (
+            b.convert_decode_to_extend() if b is not None else b
+        )
+        s.update_running_batch = Mock(side_effect=lambda b: b)
+        s._arm_prefill_decode_interval = Mock()
+        s.ngram_embedding_manager = Mock()
+        s.ngram_embedding_manager.prepare_for_forward.side_effect = lambda b, **_: b
+
+        def get_new_batch_prefill(running_batch):
+            seen.append((running_batch, running_batch.batch_is_full))
+            return NextBatchPlan(batch_to_run=None, running_batch=running_batch)
+
+        s.get_new_batch_prefill = get_new_batch_prefill
+        return s
+
+    def test_converted_batch_stays_running_and_reopens_admission(self):
+        seen = []
+        s = self._scheduler(seen)
+        running = _RunningBatch(num_reqs=3)
+
+        # Step N: decode is converted to extend because a peer rank extends.
+        plan = s.get_next_batch_to_run(running_batch=running, last_batch=None)
+        self.assertIs(plan.batch_to_run, running)
+        self.assertIs(plan.running_batch, running)
+
+        # Step N+1: one row finished; the batch comes back as last_batch.
+        running.reqs[0].finished = True
+        plan = s.get_next_batch_to_run(
+            running_batch=plan.running_batch, last_batch=plan.batch_to_run
+        )
+
+        batch, batch_is_full = seen[-1]
+        self.assertIs(batch, running)
+        self.assertEqual(running.batch_size(), 2)
+        self.assertFalse(batch_is_full)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

@@ -365,6 +365,31 @@ def test_retract_requeues_running_then_last_fold_in(self):
         self.assertIsNone(scheduler.chunked_req)
         self.assertIsNone(scheduler.last_batch)
 
+    def test_retract_after_dp_conversion_releases_each_req_once(self):
+        """retract after DP attention converted the running batch to extend
+        (running_batch is last_batch) releases each request once."""
+        scheduler = self._new_scheduler()
+        run_req_a = self._make_req("run-a")
+        run_req_b = self._make_req("run-b")
+        converted = self._make_batch(
+            scheduler,
+            reqs=[run_req_a, run_req_b],
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+            with_tensors=True,
+        )
+        scheduler.running_batch = converted
+        scheduler.last_batch = converted
+        requeue_log = self._spy_requeue(scheduler)
+
+        scheduler.pause_generation(PauseGenerationReqInput(mode="retract"))
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [entry["req"] for entry in requeue_log], [run_req_a, run_req_b]
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [req.retraction_count for req in (run_req_a, run_req_b)], [1, 1]
+        )
+
     def test_retract_with_empty_running_uses_last_batch_reqs(self):
         """retract with empty running batch releases and requeues the last extend reqs."""
         scheduler = self._new_scheduler()
